name: extract_entities
description: Extract structured entities from user message for BFS product search workflow based on actual BFS API fields

description.description: Product description as required by BFS API (REQUIRED for search)

specification.description: Technical specifications as required by BFS API (REQUIRED for search)

category.description: Product category from BFS API categories: Agriculture Equipments, Air Logistics, Automotive, Batteries & UPS, etc. (REQUIRED)

location.description: Geographic location where product is needed (REQUIRED - city name as used in BFS API)

unitofMeasures.description: Unit of measurement: pcs, kg, liters, etc. (REQUIRED for BFS API)

ageOfAsset.description: Age requirement in years: '3', '5', 'new' (OPTIONAL - can be estimated)

quantity.description: Quantity needed - numeric value (OPTIONAL - can be asked later)

buyPrice.description: Budget or max price willing to pay (OPTIONAL - may not be defined initially)

bfsGroup.description: BFS group: CAPEX - Equipment & Machinery, Admin & IT, etc. (OPTIONAL - can be derived from category)

availability_check.description: Whether this is availability inquiry (true) or purchase intent (false)

completeness.description: Percentage of BFS API required fields (description, specification, category, location, unitofMeasures) that have values

missing_required_fields.description: List of required BFS API fields that are missing: description, specification, category, location, unitofMeasures

missing_optional_fields.description: List of optional BFS API fields that could be helpful: ageOfAsset, quantity, buyPrice, bfsGroup

confidence.description: Confidence in the entity extraction accuracy
